spec.description:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Sol is an acoustic workstation divider
characterized by an organic curved semi-circular profile. Manufactured from 100%
polyester fibre with a minimum of 80% post-consumer recycled PET, Sol attaches
non-destructively to workstations using circular-economy Vicinity Workstation
Clamps. It provides desk-level speech absorption (0.30 Sabins per 600mm unit)
and visual privacy while introducing soft, arched silhouettes into modern office
environments.
features:
Distinctive arched curved Sol profile adds soft
architectural geometry to desks

Lightweight, semi-rigid 12mm or 24mm 100%
polyester acoustic screen

Constructed with a minimum of 80% post-consumer
recycled PET

Acoustic rating of 0.30 metric Sabins per unit (600mm Sol
screen)

Fixed non-destructively to desks with Vicinity Workstation Clamps
made from 100% recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705
- 2003 and AS 5637.1

Pinnable, durable, moisture-resistant, and will not
warp, slump, or fray

Safe, non-toxic, non-allergenic, and free of chemical
binders or formaldehyde

Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party
verified EPD and Declare Red List Free

Available across the full Autex Cube
colour palette and custom printed finishes

install:
Verify desktop thickness is compatible
with the clamp jaws

Position Vicinity Workstation Clamps along the desk edge
at designated centres

Tighten clamp screws beneath the desk to anchor clamps
firmly in position

Slide the curved Sol acoustic panel into the clamp
receiver slots
Check that the screen is seated fully down and sits plumb
Tighten the screen retaining screws to lock the Sol screen firmly in place
selection_checklist:
Confirm desk top thickness and edge chamfer for clamp
fitment

Confirm curved Sol profile
meets interior design aesthetic
Choose colourway from Autex Cube palette
Specify clamp mounting style (Desk Mount, Front Mount, or Top Mount)
limitations:
Designed for interior desk mounting only; not
suitable for exterior use

Curved profile has lower total surface area
compared to full rectangular screens

Cannot support mounted accessories or
heavy equipment

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Vicinity - Desk Screen
- Sol is an organic curved acoustic desk partition crafted from 12mm or 24mm
Cube semi-rigid polyester felt containing at least 80% recycled PET.
Characterized by its arched Sol silhouette, it mounts non-destructively to desks
using 100% recycled PET Vicinity clamps to absorb voice frequencies (0.30 Sabins
per 600mm unit) and provide visual privacy. Certified Group 1 fire rated under
AS ISO 9705 and carbon neutral, it softens open-plan office acoustics while
introducing fluid, contemporary geometry to workstations.
